Container.Name: mkv-autosub
Container.Overview: Watches a folder for MakeMKV rips. Keeps the video, the first audio track and any Swedish audio, OCRs the English and Swedish Blu-ray (PGS) subtitles to SRT with Subtitle Edit's command-line tool (via Ollama, with Tesseract as fallback), and remuxes everything into one .mkv. Uses Subtitle Edit (by Nikolaj Olsson) and MKVToolNix; unofficial, not affiliated with either project.

Config.Name: Watch folder
Config.Description: Where MakeMKV writes its rips. Processed files are moved to done/ (or failed/) inside this folder.

Config.Name: Output folder
Config.Description: Finished .mkv files (same sub-folder as the rip).

Config.Name: OLLAMA_URL
Config.Description: Your Ollama container: http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:11434 (change the IP)

Config.Name: OLLAMA_MODEL
Config.Description: Vision model used for OCR (pull it in the ollama container first)

Config.Name: OCR_FALLBACK
Config.Description: Engine to retry with if the main one fails. Empty = no fallback.

Config.Name: SUB_UNMATCHED
Config.Description: Subtitle tracks not tagged with a SUB_LANGS language. all = also take untagged tracks, and every track if none is tagged right (language is detected from the text). detected = same, but keep only tracks whose text is a SUB_LANGS language. none = tagged tracks only.

Config.Name: AUDIO_LANGS
Config.Description: Audio languages kept in addition to the first audio track

Config.Name: DEFAULT_SUB_LANG
Config.Description: SRT language marked as default. Empty = none.

Config.Name: OUTPUT_SUFFIX
Config.Description: Added before .mkv in the output file name (Movie-REMUX.mkv). Empty = keep the original name.

Config.Name: KEEP_PGS
Config.Description: 1 = also keep the original image subtitles of the chosen languages, 0 = SRT only

Config.Name: STABLE_MINUTES
Config.Description: Only process a rip once it hasn't changed for this many minutes (MakeMKV finished writing)
